breaking.change: Mass elements use the shared Ease type instead of MassEase.
breaking.fix: Use none, power1.out, power1.in, back.out and steps(1,end) in place of linear, out, in, back and step. Other shared curves are now supported.

breaking.change: Returns Result<number> and reports invalid timing text instead of silently substituting linear.

added.summary: Shared parameterized and named curves on the GPU through deduplicated 4097-sample lookup tables, preserving discontinuous step timing.
